messages:
Leah M.: Quick note: new 9B-catalyst model in INT4 shows ~6% top3 drop on primed multi-turn tests vs INT8. Seen in eval + 1% prod sample.
Ravi S.: can you share slice summary and a couple failing transcripts?
Leah M.: slice: priming_long_v1
INT8: top3=0.84, MRR=0.63
INT6: top3=0.82, MRR=0.61
INT4: top3=0.78, MRR=0.57
Failures cluster on contexts >800 tokens. Examples redacted and attached to scorecard.
Tom B.: hypothesis: KV quantization accumulation. fast check: run INT4 with KV disabled and compare.
Leah M.: kicking that now, plus deterministic repro. will produce a micro-scorecard (accuracy, per-token cost delta, latency tail) by EOD.
ops-bot: canary deploy 2024-06-20T09:10:00Z - model=catalyst-9b-int4 - rollout=10%
Ravi S.: include routing suggestion in scorecard: route by max_context_tokens threshold (e.g., >=512 -> INT6) and show estimated cost savings vs all-INT8.
Leah M.: early result: INT4+noKV recovers most loss (top3~0.82). suggests KV precision is main factor. full numbers in scorecard link when ready.
Tom B.: if KV is root, short-term mitigation = route long primed requests to INT6; keep INT4 for short queries to preserve cost.
Leah M.: noted. actions: repro + scorecard (Leah), tokenization sanity check (Ravi), runtime trace request if compounding error (Tom), hold further INT4 canaries (ops).
ops-bot: canary throttle applied - model=catalyst-9b-int4 - rollout set to 0%
Leah M.: will update once scorecard and transcript set are uploaded. :hourglass:
